name: skill-smith
description: Meta-tooling for developing and refining Claude Code skills. Ships skill-author: create new skills or audit/restructure existing ones against a written authoring standard (discoverable descriptions, skimmable structure, human-readable prose, correct plugin wiring). And skill-retro: a session retrospective that reviews the skills used in the current session, grades their performance with evidence, appends findings to each skill's FEEDBACK.md, and proposes concrete user-approved SKILL.md edits — the feedback loop that makes skills improve from real usage.
